text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"A race identical to today's can never 
happen again. And yet—"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't run the way I wanted to at all. 
I didn't have any fun.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Why did I run like that, I wonder? Even I 
don't really know.
choice_data_list: Then let's go find the answer!
Let's think about what to do next.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that sounds great! I'm in!

"...Afterward, following Mr. C.B.'s whims, 
we wandered around searching for the 
answers she was looking for."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. In the end, there's only one thing 
to do. Run in the race, plain and simple.”

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'll leave today's run in today. Taking 
only the frustration with me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'll leave that behind in the next race. 
The moment I win, that is.
